rv.q: The play mets my three criteria: you learn from it, you learn about yourself, and it’s entertaining.
This commentary, while satirical, is meant to shed light on the complexities of Black people, rejecting the ideology that, more often than not, wants to put us in a neat little box.

The writing, directing, and performances really do come together in a production that highlights real issues while prioritizing the fun and quite frankly the mental health of the black people working on the production and sitting in the audience.

cn.t: This satirical exploration of Black American identity through eleven vignettes proves compelling and educational, though one critic initially approached with skepticism about such spotlight productions.
